source: Wikipedia episode table for Rick Steves' Europe (2000-2025) -- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rick_Steves%27_Europe

assumptions.start_date: episode original air date (the only date the source publishes; filming predates it)
assumptions.trip_shape: round trip out of Seattle, nonstop each way
assumptions.flights_only: an episode is kept only if a nonstop from SEA to the destination airport exists in airline_routes_enhanced.csv
assumptions.route_data_vintage: airline_routes_enhanced.csv is a present-day route snapshot, not a 2000-2025 schedule -- exclusions mean 'no nonstop today'
assumptions.seattle_europe_gap: SEA has a present-day nonstop to exactly six European airports (CDG, LHR, FRA, AMS, DUB, KEF), which is why most of this show's destinations are excluded -- see this script's docstring
assumptions.capital_rule_episodes: episodes titled by COUNTRY only get that country's CAPITAL as the destination -- see the capital rule in chef_trips.py
assumptions.single_home_airport: SEA only, unlike the three-airport preferences the New York and Los Angeles travelers use -- Rick Steves' declared base has one major airport
assumptions.home_airport: Seattle-Tacoma (SEA) -- Rick Steves lives in Edmonds, WA and the show's company is headquartered there
